name: Kemomimi☆Training ~Kyoubou Kemomimi Reijou Choukyou Trial
original_name: ケモミミ☆トレーニング ～狂暴けもみみ令嬢調教トライアル
source:
The protagonist is working at the Reapers Club.
Or, at least he was, until he broke a precious vase, and milady Shiine fired his ass.
Crippled with debt, his only choice to pay everything back is to become a "Trainer".
His first job is to straighten up a famously aggressive kemomimi girl...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ356209.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角在收割者俱乐部工作。
或者，至少他是，直到他打碎了一个珍贵的花瓶，而席恩夫人开枪打死了他。
负债累累的他唯一的选择就是成为一名“训练师”来偿还一切。
他的第一份工作是纠正一个出了名好斗的克莫米米女孩……
